_about: The EuRoC consistency gate (#605): scripts/euroc-consistency.sh. diverge_ratio (10x OpenVINS mono's window 4-DoF ATE, the threshold #602 used) was set on 2026-11-07 before any estimator ran. The third condition was first a median yaw ANEES <= 3; review of PR #607 showed that ANEES is unsound (its error is relative to the gauge anchor but its denominator omits the anchor variance and the cross-time covariance), so it was replaced after the first results by yaw_sigma_ratio_min: the median over the matched runs of (smallest world-yaw sigma / world-yaw sigma at the anchor). The 0.5 bound lets the marginal yaw sigma fall through its correlation with observable states (the R-IEKF's runs go down to 0.52) but not collapse; the first results (MSCKF median 0.076, at most 0.127; R-IEKF median 0.90) pass or fail the same at any bound between 0.13 and 0.9. 'backends' holds each backend's recorded results (--record). Since #613 every run takes its IMU, its ideal tracks and its score from one truth, a cubic B-spline through the ground truth (vio_pipeline --imu gt, traj_eval --truth), with the track noise drawn in normalized coordinates, so matched R and Q are the true noise; both backends use the same shipped S6d gate. Results recorded before #613 compared the real IMU with the raw ground truth, whose error made matched R untrue and let the chi-square gate starve the filters; they were replaced. Each run records its normalized NIS.
